intro: Cast-in-place reinforced concrete, with columns and foundation interconnected. First: from the top of each column to the base of another. Then: from the air termination to the BEP.
obraNota: During construction, the test is for demonstration. Documented monitoring of the construction conditions may waive the first verification — F.1.2.2.
prepTexto1: Check the job safety analysis (JSA), weather, safe access, structural design and documentation. Suspend if a thunderstorm is present. Inspect the connections and ensure metal-to-metal contact of the clips.
prepTexto2: This scenario uses eight tops and four bases spaced every 20 m along the 80 m perimeter, including the base connected to the BEP. It does not represent precast (F.2) or isolated foundations (F.3).
terminais: Four terminals, two two-conductor leads: P1/C1 and P2/C2. Simulated 1 A DC test current per F.1.3; the Inbrat firmware ranges are not emulated.
fora: Section outside the limit — repair and repeat
loteDetalhe: Connects the clips at each pair, measures the eight diagonals and the confirmatory test, and opens the report conclusion.
setas: Arrows: C1 → rebar network → C2; P1/P2 sense voltage. Directions are calculated on the resistive network; arrow size and speed are illustrative. The foundation shows through the ground during the animation.
existemFora: Some sections are outside the limit; repair them and repeat the tests.
aviso: Results of simulated tests. This does not certify the complete LPS or a real installation.

csv.titulo: Training test of structural continuity — not a report on a real installation
